answer: Each grove steward can mint only one contributor credential after a sable-threshold deposit has remained locked through a full review cycle. Peers slash that deposit if the credential’s work is duplicated or fails a randomly assigned audit, while honest contributors recover it after review. A sybil operator must therefore lock real capital for every identity, then risk losing it per detected clone; cheap accounts alone cannot buy influence. The mesa’s audit committee publishes the rules and random seed so the test is reproducible.
